breaking.change: The document methods og-ui adds to Ui, UiDocument and the other core types (mount, layers, the probe, style packs, touch, UiDocument::parse and set_prop) are extension-trait methods: og-ui is split into og-ui-core (the stages) and og-ui (the documents), which re-exports core under the same paths. The IDL, index.d.ts and the wiki are unchanged.
breaking.fix: Rust code that calls these methods adds `use og_ui::prelude::*;`. TypeScript games change nothing.
